publisher_reference: Neto et al., CICIoT2023, Sensors 23(13):5941, doi:10.3390/s23135941 (PMC10346235): sec. 3.2 - '7 Raspberry Pi devices ... responsible for executing the attacks'; Table 1 lists Raspberry Pi 4 MACs DC:A6:32:C9:E6:F4, DC:A6:32:C9:E4:C6, DC:A6:32:C9:E5:02 and no Raspberry Pi victim; Table 2 tools: udp-flood (UDP Flood), hping3 (SYN/ICMP floods); sec. 3.4 - publisher labels the entire capture of each attack as that attack.

rules.label: attack
rules.note: DC:A6:32 is the Raspberry Pi 4 OUI. Using the OUI (not only the 3 listed MACs) covers all 7 attacker Pis; before training, verify on the capture that <=7 distinct DC:A6:32 source MACs appear and that no victim device has this OUI.

note: The current runtime never marks ICMP flows complete, so this rule yields no training rows until ICMP completion is defined.
